The parent budget is 1800 seconds. The old original q_all extended run used a separately recorded 7200-second supervised budget and actually took 3276.426 seconds. A fresh corrected q_all 7200-second run needs its own explicit one-attempt extension and resource guards; do not silently relabel 7200 as the parent setting.
The old extended builder was jetson_build_qdq.py with no explicit precisionConstraints flag in the actual command. It therefore is not a matched obey/prefer build control for a new Python Builder.
New corrected common_preparation must differ from old preparation. Shared weights, calibration and output names do not establish a matched nonquantized float/fusion control.
